prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Miami. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Miami for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but to give you the best, specific names and phone numbers I need one quick detail: what part of Miami are you in or which zip code do you want to be near? Also tell me whether you prefer braces vs Invisalign, whether you have orthodontic insurance, and whether this is for an adult or a child/teen.

If you want to decide quickly, here’s a practical plan plus what to ask when you call so you get the right provider:

How I’ll pick specific offices for you
- Proximity to your neighborhood/zip code
- Board certification (American Board of Orthodontics) when possible
- Invisalign provider level (Gold/Platinum/Diamond) or many years of clear-aligner experience if you want Invisalign
- Good recent patient reviews and before/after photos
- Transparent pricing/financing and insurance acceptance
- Availability for emergencies and reasonable appointment hours

Immediate steps you can take right now
1. Use Invisalign’s “Find a doctor” tool (invisalign.com → Find a Provider) to locate experienced Invisalign doctors near you. That gives provider-level status and contact info.
2. Use the American Association of Orthodontists (aaoinfo.org/orthodontist) to find board-certified specialists.
3. Check Google/Yelp reviews and the doctor’s before/after gallery on their website.

Important questions to ask when you call (exact wording you can use)
- “Is Dr. X a board-certified orthodontist (American Board of Orthodontics)?”
- “How many Invisalign cases have you treated? What is your provider level (Gold/Platinum/Diamond)?”
- “Do you treat adults/teens with similar cases to mine? Can I see before/after photos of similar cases?”
- “What are the estimated time and total cost for my case, and what’s included (retainers, refinements, follow-ups)?”
- “Do you accept my insurance? Do you offer financing or in-office payment plans?”
- “How do you handle emergencies and broken appliances outside business hours?”
- “How often will I need to come in for visits if I choose Invisalign vs braces?”

What I can do next for you
- If you give me your Miami neighborhood or zip code (and the preferences above), I’ll compile a short list (4–6) of highly rated orthodontists in your area, with a brief reason to call each (e.g., board certification, Invisalign status, adult experience), plus phone numbers and addresses.
